description: Recreate the Home (/) and Services (/services) pages with verbatim copy from CONTENT_INVENTORY.md, using the FEAT-001 component library. Implement the seven ServiceCards (01-07) with single-hash anchor ids and smooth-scroll (removing the production double-hash ## defect). Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Read context.json and CONTENT_INVENTORY.md sections 'Page: Home' and 'Page: Services' FIRST. Add verbatim page copy to src/content/pages.ts and per-route meta to src/content/seo.ts.

Implement src/pages/Home.tsx per CONTENT_INVENTORY.md 'Page: Home': single H1 'Financial clarity. Stronger controls. Better business decisions.', hero sub-copy, hero image public/hero.jpg (alt text), 6-service list, 'Why KR Advisory Group' section, 'Who We Help' three AudienceCards, Public Sector Advisory band, Referral teaser, closing CTA band. CTAs: Explore Our Services (-> /services), Book a Consultation (WhatsApp prefilled), WhatsApp Us, Refer a Business (-> /referral).

Implement src/pages/Services.tsx per CONTENT_INVENTORY.md 'Page: Services': single H1 'Our Services', intro, and seven ServiceCard components (01 Accounting ... 07 Public Sector Advisory) with exact promise lines and the full verbatim 'What this includes' lists from src/content/services.ts. Each card gets a single-hash anchor id (accounting, tax, internal-audit, audit-readiness, business-advisory, funding-support, public-sector) and Book a Consultation / WhatsApp Us CTAs.
Wire single-hash smooth-scroll via src/lib/scroll.ts on /services (respect prefers-reduced-motion); ensure nav/service deep-links use /services#<id> (single hash) and NOT the double-hash ## defect.
Commit locally (do NOT push): 'feat: add Home and Services pages with single-hash service anchors'. Set FEAT-002 status to completed and note anything FEAT-003/004 need in findings.
acceptance_criteria: dist/index.html contains the exact H1 'Financial clarity. Stronger controls.' substring and the hero sub-copy.
dist/services/index.html contains 'Our Services' and all seven anchor ids (id="accounting" ... id="public-sector") with their verbatim 'What this includes' items.
No link emits a double-hash (##) anchor; service deep-links are single-hash /services#<id>.
npm run build succeeds with no type errors.
verification: Confirm dist/index.html contains 'Financial clarity. Stronger controls.'
Confirm dist/services/index.html contains 'Our Services' and 'id="accounting"' and 'id="public-sector"'
Grep the src and built output to confirm no occurrence of '##' in anchor hrefs
findings:
Home (/) and Services (/services) implemented with verbatim copy; both registered in src/routes.tsx (already present from FEAT-001). Build passes with no type errors; dist/index.html has the full H1 'Financial clarity. Stronger controls. Better business decisions.' + hero sub-copy; dist/services/index.html has 'Our Services', id="accounting" ... id="public-sector", and all verbatim 'What this includes' items. Exactly one H1 per page. Zero double-hash (##) hrefs in dist (grep count 0); the only '##' in src is a comment in src/lib/scroll.ts describing the removed defect. Service deep-links are single-hash /services#<id> (Home service cards + Footer).
